hero_h: Your favorite AI models, with privacy you can verify.
hero_p: Find the right model for writing, coding, and everyday tasks. Use it in chat or through our API, all from one prepaid balance.
enclave_h: Your chat traffic stays unreadable to us.
enclave_p1: PPQ routes chat requests through a secure enclave: an isolated hardware environment that keeps your prompts and replies out of our ordinary servers and logs.
enclave_p2: We receive the metadata needed to route and bill for your requests. The contents of your chat traffic remain protected from us.
proof_p: Published enclave code, reproducible builds, and independent verification tools let you examine the protection behind the promise.
enclave_note: This protection covers chat requests. Other features have different processing paths.
privacy_h: Know what your model provider can see.
privacy_p: Protection from PPQ is one part of the picture. Your model’s privacy label explains what happens when the request reaches its provider.
anon_p: The provider can read your prompt and may retain it under its policies.
zdr_p: The provider processes your request under an agreement not to store prompts or replies.
e2ee_p: The model itself runs inside a protected enclave, shielding the conversation’s contents from its hosting provider.
privacy_note: API protections depend on configuration and supported features. Zero Data Retention must be enabled for API requests.
models_h: Choose the model for the task.
models_p1: Use Claude for one project, GPT for another, or explore open-weight alternatives. Choose based on capability, price, and privacy, without setting up a separate provider account for each.
models_p2: Your balance works across the models available through PPQ, so you can change your approach as your needs change.
usage_h: Your AI spending follows your usage.
usage_p: Add prepaid credit and use it when you need AI. There’s no PPQ subscription and no separate monthly plan for each model.
job_h: Match the model to the job
job_p: Choose a lower-cost model for straightforward tasks and a more capable one for demanding work.
pay_p: Text requests are charged by the model’s rates and the amount of input and output processed, including conversation context.
balance_p: Use your credit across PPQ chat and requests from connected apps.
api_h: Your models can work beyond this chat.
api_p1: An API lets other apps use the models available through PPQ. Connect a compatible coding assistant, research workspace, or automation tool with your PPQ API key.
api_p2: You choose the tool and model. PPQ provides the model access and charges its usage to your existing balance.
connection_p: Use PPQ’s API instead of managing separate credentials and balances for each model provider.
supported_p: Follow a setup guide, choose a compatible model, and send your first request.
wallet_p1: Fund your balance with Bitcoin, Lightning, or Monero. No email registration required.
wallet_p2: Choose your models, use them in chat or connected tools, and keep track of your spending in one place.
wallet_note: No PPQ subscription · One prepaid balance
close_h: More choice in AI. More control over how you use it.
close_p: Choose your models and privacy protections. Start in chat or connect your tools through the API, paying as you go.
